arxiv-2211-12871.title: High-efficiency coupled-cavity optical frequency comb generation Journal: oe Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2211-12871.creator: M. P. Mrozowski, 1,* J. Jeffers, 1 and J. D. Pritchard 1
arxiv-2211-12871.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by M. P. Mrozowski, 1,* J. Jeffers, 1 and J. D. Pritchard 1. We present a high efficiency source of picosecond pulses derived from a dual cavity optical frequency comb generator. This approach overcomes the limitations of single cavity comb generators that are restricted to efficiencies of a few percent.

arxiv-2303-15368.title: 2S-UDF: A Novel Two-stage UDF Learning Method for Robust Non-watertight Model Reconstruction from Multi-view Images
arxiv-2303-15368.creator: Junkai Deng, Fei Hou, Xuhui Chen, Wencheng Wang, Ying He
arxiv-2303-15368.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Junkai Deng, Fei Hou, Xuhui Chen, Wencheng Wang, Ying He. Recently, building on the foundation of neural radiance field, various techniques have emerged to learn unsigned distance fields (UDF) to reconstruct 3D non-watertight models from multi-view images. Yet, a central challenge in UDF-based volume rendering is formulating a proper way to convert unsigned distance values into volume density, ensuring that the resulting weight function remains unbiased and sensitive to occlusions.

arxiv-2310-01848.title: Uncertain random geometric programming problems
arxiv-2310-01848.creator: Tapas Mondal*, Akshay Kumar Ojha, Sabyasachi Pani
arxiv-2310-01848.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce a deterministic formulation for the geometric programming problem, wherein the coefficients are represented as independent linear-normal uncertain random variables. To address the challenges posed by this combination of uncertainty and randomness, we introduce the concept of an uncertain random variable and present a novel framework known as the linear-normal uncertain random variable.

arxiv-2407-12959.title: A threshold for relative hyperbolicity in random right-angled Coxeter groups
arxiv-2407-12959.creator: Jason Behrstock, R. Altar Çiçeksiz, Victor Falgas-Ravry
arxiv-2407-12959.description: Abstract We consider the random right-angled Coxeter group W Γ W_{\Gamma} whose presentation graph Γ ∼ 𝒢 n , p \Gamma\sim\mathcal{G}_{n,p} is an Erdős–Rényi random graph on n n vertices with edge probability p = p ⁡ ( n ) p=p(n) .

arxiv-2511-15086.title: On relationship among three types of Birkhoff-James orthogonality Thanks: The fourth named author was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number JP24K06788. The research of the first named author is sponsored by Tokyo University of Science Post-Doctoral Fellowship under the supervision of the fourth nam
arxiv-2511-15086.creator: Soumitra Daptari, Koki Igarashi, Jumpei Nakamura, Ryotaro Tanaka
arxiv-2511-15086.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study three types of Birkhoff-James orthogonality in Hilbert C ∗ C^{*} -modules, that is, the strong, quasi-strong, and original Birkhoff-James orthogonality. In general, the strong Birkhoff-James orthogonality is stronger than the quasi-strong Birkhoff-James orthogonality, and the quasi-strong Birkhoff-James orthogonality is stronger than the original Birkhoff-James orthogonality.

arxiv-2601-19370.title: On the Analysis of Platooned Vehicular Networks on Highways
arxiv-2601-19370.creator: Kaushlendra Pandey, Harpreet S. Dhillon, Abhishek K. Gupta
arxiv-2601-19370.description: Abstract Vehicular platooning refers to coordinated and close movement of vehicular users (VUs) traveling together along a common route segment, offering strategic benefits such as reduced fuel costs, lower emissions, and improved traffic flow. Highways offer a natural setting for platooning due to extended travel distances, yet their potential remains underexplored, particularly in terms of communication and connectivity.

pmc-10582327.title: Echocardiography and laboratory outcomes of COVID-19 in children with a history of Kawasaki disease: a preliminary observation
pmc-10582327.creator: Mindy Ming-Huey Guo, Ling-Sai Chang, Yu-Jhen Chen, Ho-Chang Kuo
pmc-10582327.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundInfection with SARS-CoV-2 virus has been associated with cardiovascular sequelae including multisystem inflammatory syndrome (MIS-C) in children. Patients with a prior history of Kawasaki disease, may be more susceptible to changes in echocardiographic or laboratory findings after COVID-19.

pmc-10611160.title: Pet Owners’ Attitudes and Opinions towards Cat and Dog Care Practices in Aotearoa New Zealand
pmc-10611160.creator: Rachel Forrest, Maria Pearson, Leena Awawdeh, Giada Cordoni
pmc-10611160.description: Simple SummaryThis research aimed to explore cat and dog owners’ attitudes towards various pet care practices in Aotearoa New Zealand (NZ). An online survey was conducted from January to March 2019, and 2358 people responded to the pet care questions.

pmc-11460934.title: The causal relationship between rheumatoid arthritis and interstitial lung disease in East Asian population: A two-sample Mendelian randomization study
pmc-11460934.creator: Xiang Sun, Peipei Huang, Lingshan Gao, Weixing Zhong, Lixia Yuan
pmc-11460934.description: To investigate the causal relationship between rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and interstitial lung disease (ILD) in the East Asian population, we utilized Mendelian randomization (MR). Publicly available summarized data from genome-wide association studies on RA (4199 cases and 208,254 controls), and the data on ILD (1046 cases and 176,974 controls) were obtained from BioBank Japan.

pmc-11474412.title: Recovery From COVID-19–Related Disruptions in Cancer Detection
pmc-11474412.creator: Uriel Kim, Johnie Rose, Bryan T. Carroll, Richard S. Hoehn, Eric Chen, Jeremy S. Bordeaux, Siran M. Koroukian
pmc-11474412.description: This cross-sectional study compares observed vs expected rates of cancer diagnosis in the US during the first and second years of the COVID-19 pandemic to assess disruptions to and recovery in cancer detection. Introduction The COVID-19 pandemic was disruptive to the delivery of oncologic services across the entire cancer care spectrum, impacting screening,1,2 diagnosis,3,4 treatment,5 and survivorship.

pmc-11476928.title: Intracranial Aneurysms and Cerebral Small Vessel Disease: Is There an Association between Large- and Small-Artery Diseases?
pmc-11476928.creator: Vanessa M. Swiatek, Stefanie Schreiber, Amir Amini, David Hasan, Ali Rashidi, Klaus-Peter Stein, Belal Neyazi, I. Erol Sandalcioglu
pmc-11476928.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objectives: Intracranial aneurysms (IAs) may be connected to interactions between large and small intracranial vessels. We aimed to investigate the association between IAs and cerebral small-vessel disease (CSVD) and assess CSVD impact on IA patient management. Methods: This retrospective study analyzed clinical data and MRI features of CSVD in 192 subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) patients: 136 with incidental IA, 147 with severe CSVD without SAH/IA, and 50 controls without SAH, IA, or severe CSVD.

pmc-11495488.title: Raccoons Reveal Hidden Diversity in Trabecular Bone Development
pmc-11495488.creator: T Reinecke, K D Angielczyk
pmc-11495488.description: SynopsisTrabecular bone, and its ability to rapidly modify its structure in response to strain exerted on skeletal elements, has garnered increased attention from researchers with the advancement of CT technology that allows for the analysis of its complex lattice-like framework. Much of this research has focused on adults of select taxa, but analysis into trabecular development across ontogeny remains limited.

pmc-11643962.title: Exploring 4,7-Disubstituted Pyrimido[4,5-d]pyrimidines as Antiviral and Anticancer Agents
pmc-11643962.creator: Eleftheria A. Georgiou, Konstantinos Paraskevas, Christina Koutra, Leentje Persoons, Dominique Schols, Steven De Jonghe, Ioannis K. Kostakis
pmc-11643962.description: Thirteen new 4,7-disubstituted pyrimido[4,5-d]pyrimidines were synthesized via a straightforward methodology starting from thiourea. The anti-proliferative activity of these compounds was evaluated across a diverse panel of eight cancer cell lines, with derivatives 7d and 7h showing efficacy against several hematological cancer types. Furthermore, all compounds were assessed for their antiviral potency against a panel of viruses.

pmc-12659812.title: A Pilot Test of an AI Voice-Driven Simulation With Feedback for Medical Students to Practice Discussing Diagnostic Mammogram Results With Patients
pmc-12659812.creator: Warren S Comulada, Patricia A Ganz, Yue Ming Huang, Dan Weisman, Alanna Sugarman, Daniel Lee, Saachi Shah, Lillian Gelberg
pmc-12659812.description: IntroductionEffective communication when delivering sensitive results or bad news to patients is necessary for medical professionals, warranting greater attention in medical education. The opportunity to practice communication skills with human standardized patients has limitations, including not being readily available, prompting researchers to develop virtual patients (VPs) to supplement training with a focus on routine tasks.

pmc-13169572.title: Sputum-negative pulmonary tuberculosis in Shanghai, China: notification, clinical characteristics and outcomes
pmc-13169572.creator: Zheyuan Wu, Yaohan Zhou, Jing Chen, Lixin Rao, Xiao Xiao, Ping Zu, Xin Shen, Wenhong Zhang
pmc-13169572.description: BackgroundWith the scaling up of WHO-recommended diagnostics, 40% of pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) cases were still clinically diagnosed without sputum biological confirmation in China. To better understand this early paucibacillary disease, we explored notification, clinical characteristics and outcomes of sputum-negative PTB in Shanghai, China.MethodsWe accessed PTB surveillance data in Shanghai, China, from 2010 to 2019.

pmc-13278504.title: Nurse-led menstrual hygiene management package to improve menstrual health practices among university students: Randomised waitlist-controlled protocol study
pmc-13278504.creator: Ranjita Devi, Barkha Devi, Rubi Dey, Shraddha Deokota
pmc-13278504.description: BACKGROUND:Despite the cost, disposal issues, risk of infections and environmental burden, sanitary pads continue to be the most used method of menstrual hygiene among young women in India. Menstrual cups are a safer, cost-effective and environmentally friendly option, but acceptance is very low because of myths, cultural taboos and absence of organised education.

pmc-13337410.title: Post-disaster psychological effects: identifying earthquake-induced trauma in athletes
pmc-13337410.creator: Fatih Mehmet Uğurlu, Muhammed Güler, Veysel Albayrak, Caner Aygören

pmc-13380922.title: Exploring Intergenerational Dialogues as a Strategy to Reduce Rejection of Young Single Mothers in Rwanda: A Qualitative Study
pmc-13380922.creator: Anna Dusabe, Samuel Habimana, Isabelle Kubwimana, Judy N Khanyola, Maxwell Mhlanga, Tsion Yohannes, Augustine Ndaimani
pmc-13380922.description: IntroductionTeenage pregnancy is a major global public health concern, with an estimated 21 million adolescent girls giving birth each year globally. Despite the growing implementation of dialogue-based interventions, limited evidence exists regarding how participants perceive their effectiveness within family and community systems in Rwanda.
